status: COMPLETE UPDATED IMPLEMENTATION PROPOSAL; no runtime changes or new project runs; all declared models compile; runtime refinement and campaign remain planned
scope: Run-aware restricted C2 table and explicit bounded raw emitter image
Abstract EXACT/MUST FLOW point tails; field-write E; whole-position RemoveAll
Canonical FLOW summary pairs and C5 returned pieces; raw preimages/containment
Both-order concrete STAR delivery; native abstract-MUST backward views
P1 internal filtered C5 lookup and fixed-right branch pruning
P2 immutable owner-family IDs and per-visible-view eligibility memo
userDecisions: Use a retained NORMAL STAR/STAR FLOW relation to subsume the corresponding exact relation; verify an actual cover exists.
New abstract MUST summary premises require definite MUST input.
Demand p.ANY/T + actual p.STAR/T DEMAND emits nothing.
Demand p.f.ANY/FLOW + actual p.ANY/T DEMAND emits p.f.ANY/FLOW.
Normalize each pure FLOW summary EXACT endpoint to STAR before storage; retain both paths/bases, marks, layer, E, and mark exclusions.
Record ordinary field-write E on derived EXACT/FLOW conclusions and preserve it through moves and returns; raw EXACT initial query E remains empty.
Keep run1 exclusion update -> DEMAND/EmptyE; persist later NORMAL E.
RemoveAll clears the selected whole position and descendants. Named p.f is valid; below-only/exact-only variants are prohibited.
Reject terminal-AnyField RemoveAll configuration rather than silently interpreting it as a whole-parent removal; low-level null-mark reach must be AT_AND_BELOW. Selected RemoveMark is unchanged.
Keep raw exact query points. The temporary general entry-STAR alternative was revoked; summary normalization remains selected.
Run-2: STAR/M demand plus a compatible proper-descendant submitted fact emits requested STAR/M at the demand prefix. Use the actual after the field cut and retain concrete mark/E gates.
From run-2, outgoing pure FLOW DEMAND is MAY/ANY, Empty E, no MUST certainty. Run-2 alone consumes STAR/FLOW entry demand from run-1; later such entries are invalid.
The entry Dc restriction does not ban STAR in paired exit Dp, NORMAL summaries or initial facts that refine ANY.
Later concrete STAR/T admission retains precise EXACT-at-demand cells and rejects proper descendants. Concrete STAR starts and remains DEMAND.
inferredPolicyCell: The unchanged scalar table rejects a broader STAR actual under an ANY demand; it does not refine ANY. Same-prefix STAR demand keeps the former EXACT result. The run-2 descendant override is not extended to these cells.
